snippet.title: Rogue Company - Season 4 - Battle Pass Trailer
snippet.description:
The Season Four Battle Pass features four new sinister outfits, a mythic weapon wrap, and many other cosmetics, boosts, and Rogue Bucks! Play Season Four of Rogue Company for FREE and earn new rewards with the Battle Pass!
